text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling after steep declines turned losses into realized losses; I should set a reasoned exit plan before trading and reassess the investment case rather than react to price drops.","Buying more after a rebound or adding large positions without clear evidence can increase risk; I should size purchases carefully and avoid treating recent gains as proof of recovery.","My trades have been frequent and shifting across stocks while account value remains below its early level; I should review the entire portfolio, preserve diversification and cash, and trade only when the long-term case justifies it."]}
